necessary_context.content: A is m×n; x is the minimizing strategy and y the maximizing strategy. One arbitrary-real-vector query returns the pair (Ax,A^T y). Outputs must be feasible. Ball–simplex uses B_2^n×Delta_m with maximum row Euclidean norm at most one; simplex–simplex uses Delta_n×Delta_m with maximum entry absolute value at most one.
necessary_context.name: Game models and query unit

necessary_context.content: Definition 3.1 fixes success at least 2/3 on every admissible game. An at-most-T budget is an almost-sure hard cap on every transcript, including off-promise transcripts. Gaussian spectral estimation instead has a universal failure floor gamma; the source residual solver uses success 3/5. These are different interfaces.
necessary_context.locator: Definition 3.1 and following convention, p.5; Theorem 5.4, pp.12–13; Definition 6.1, p.13
necessary_context.name: Budget and probability scope

necessary_context.content: Theorem 4.1 imports a finite-dimensional Gaussian smallest-singular-value estimate from Huang–Tikhomirov; Proposition 4.2 imports a Gaussian operator-norm tail. Those external originals were not checked here. Section 8 explicitly describes the adaptive core argument as the central unresolved verification task and qualifies the conclusions as subject to proof verification. Page-1 AI/Lean audit disclosure is an author assertion, not an independent receipt inspected here.
